titles.zh: 大秦景教流行中国碑（原石）
titles.en: Stele of the Diffusion of the Luminous Religion, original stone

dimensions.note: Body only; the museum page gives no total height with the turtle base.

currentCollection.note: The museum page states that the stone was moved into the Beilin in October 1907 and is displayed there.
currentCollection.noteZh: 馆方页面称此碑于 1907 年 10 月移入碑林并陈列于此。

date.note: The endpoints are two alternative dates in Beilin publications.

provenanceEvents.summary: Two Beilin articles give different find dates and location descriptions. The collection catalogue places the find near Chongren Temple in 1625; the other article gives western Xi’an in 1623.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 碑林两篇资料的出土时间、地点表述有异：馆藏目录作 1625 年西安城西崇仁寺（金胜寺）附近，另一条目作 1623 年西安西郊。

provenanceEvents.summary: Moved into the Beilin after a purchase attempt by the Danish collector Holm was stopped; only his copy left the country.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 丹麦人何乐模企图购运原石未成，碑身与龟趺于此后数日移入碑林，出国的是复制碑。

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft object record from the museum page. The 1907 episode is summarized from that page without checking Holm’s own account.
review.noteZh: 项目负责人于 2026-11-18 审核并同意发布。审核前的证据记录：依据馆方页面整理的草稿；1907 年一段仅据该页面，未核对何乐模本人记述。

notes: The museum page states the date, authors, body size, and 1907 move; it does not give the total height, weight, or present display condition.
No accession number is recorded, and the page does not say whether the stone is on public view today.
No coordinate is recorded: the page names an institution, not a surveyed point.
The page calls the stele one of the world’s four famous steles without defining the set.
notesZh: 馆方页面记载了年代、撰书人、碑身尺寸与 1907 年迁移，但没有给出通高、重量与今日保存状况。
未见入藏编号，也没有说明此碑今日是否公开展陈。
未记录坐标：页面给出的是机构名称，不是实测点位。
页面称此碑为「世界四大名碑」之一，但未说明这一名目的具体所指。
